import cv2 as cv
import numpy as np
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt
In [88]:
def imshow(img, nome=""):
    plt.imshow(img)
    plt.box(False)
    plt.xticks([])
    plt.yticks([])
    if nome:
        plt.savefig(nome, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.show()

Segmentação de Cores¶

seg_img = cv.cvtColor(img, cv.COLOR_RGB2HSV)
In [139]:
h = seg_img[:, :, 0].flatten()
s = seg_img[:, :, 1].flatten()
v = seg_img[:, :, 2].flatten()
c = img.reshape((-1, 3)) / 255

H = [2, 20]
S = [70, 255]
V = [50, 255]

plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
plt.scatter(h, s, c=c)
plt.ylabel('S')
plt.xticks([])
for x in H:
    plt.axvline(x)
for x in S:
    plt.axhline(x)

plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
plt.scatter(v, s, c=c)
plt.xlabel('V')
plt.yticks([])
for x in S:
    plt.axhline(x)
for x in V:
    plt.axvline(x)

plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
plt.scatter(h, v, c=c)
plt.xlabel('H')
plt.ylabel('V')
for x in H:
    plt.axvline(x)
for x in V:
    plt.axhline(x)

plt.show()

Alteração de Máscaras¶

In [452]:
img = cv.cvtColor(cv.imread("./orangex.png"), cv.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
imshow(img, 'original3.png')
In [453]:
seg_img = cv.cvtColor(img, cv.COLOR_RGB2HSV)
mask = cv.inRange(seg_img, (H[0], S[0], V[0]), (H[1], S[1], V[1]))
result = cv.bitwise_and(img, img, mask=mask)
imshow(result, "mascarado3.png")
In [454]:
kernel_size = 10
kernel = np.ones((kernel_size, kernel_size),np.uint8)
erosion = cv.erode(mask,kernel,iterations = 1)
result = cv.bitwise_and(img, img, mask=erosion)
imshow(result, "mascarado4.png")
In [455]:
kernel_size = 10
kernel = np.ones((kernel_size, kernel_size),np.uint8)
dilation = cv.dilate(erosion,kernel,iterations = 1)
result = cv.bitwise_and(img, img, mask=dilation)
imshow(result, "mascarado5.png")

Haar¶

In [447]:
img = cv.cvtColor(cv.imread("./face.png"), cv.COLOR_BGR2RGB)

face_cascade_name = './haarcascade_frontalface_alt.xml'
eyes_cascade_name = './haarcascade_eye.xml'

face_cascade = cv.CascadeClassifier()
eyes_cascade = cv.CascadeClassifier()

face_cascade.load(cv.samples.findFile(face_cascade_name))
eyes_cascade.load(cv.samples.findFile(eyes_cascade_name))

frame_gray = cv.cvtColor(img, cv.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
frame_gray = cv.equalizeHist(frame_gray)
In [448]:
imshow(img, 'originalg.png')
imshow(cv.cvtColor(frame_gray, cv.COLOR_GRAY2RGB), 'grayg.png')
In [449]:
faces = face_cascade.detectMultiScale(frame_gray)
In [450]:
for face in faces:
    x, y, w, h = face
    plt.plot([x, x+w, x+w, x, x], [y, y, y+h, y+h, y], c='g')

    faceROI = frame_gray[y:y+h,x:x+w]
    eyes = eyes_cascade.detectMultiScale(faceROI)

    for eye in eyes:
        _x, _y, _w, _h = eye
        _x += x
        _y += y
        plt.plot([_x, _x+_w, _x+_w, _x, _x], [_y, _y, _y+_h, _y+_h, _y], c='m')
imshow(img, 'haarg.png')
In [451]:
img = cv.cvtColor(cv.imread("./people.png"), cv.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
imshow(img, 'originalp.png')

frame_gray = cv.cvtColor(img, cv.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
frame_gray = cv.equalizeHist(frame_gray)

faces = face_cascade.detectMultiScale(frame_gray)
for face in faces:
    x, y, w, h = face
    plt.plot([x, x+w, x+w, x, x], [y, y, y+h, y+h, y], c='g')

    faceROI = frame_gray[y:y+h,x:x+w]
    eyes = eyes_cascade.detectMultiScale(faceROI)

    for eye in eyes:
        _x, _y, _w, _h = eye
        _x += x
        _y += y
        plt.plot([_x, _x+_w, _x+_w, _x, _x], [_y, _y, _y+_h, _y+_h, _y], c='m')
imshow(img, 'haarp.png')
